content.text: In the discussion channel, a user asked how to bridge funds from Base to Solana, though no answer was provided in the conversation. Separately, two users exchanged accusations of being scammers toward one another, with no resolution or moderation noted. Additionally, a user named Selcuk introduced a project called Coopa v4.0, which has been deployed on the Sepolia testnet. He described it as a zero-trust Digital Sanctuary that performs full client-side encryption before storing files and messages permanently on Irys and Arweave, meaning even the project servers cannot access stored data. Selcuk stated he is looking for power users to stress-test the architecture and provide honest feedback on the user experience. He shared the live app at coopaassistant.com and noted that Sepolia ETH for testing can be obtained at sepoliafaucet.com. He invited users to reply or send a direct message with bug reports or feature ideas.
